Adding pagination to Products endpoint is a scoped fix affecting the route handler and test file. Requires adding query parameters, applying limits, and returning pagination metadata. No architectural refactoring needed.
Adding pagination to Feedbacks endpoint follows the same pattern as Products. Localized to feedback route handler and test. Deterministic fix with no cross-cutting concerns.
Adding pagination to Users endpoint is similar to Products and Feedbacks. Scoped to users route and test. Security benefit from reducing exposed user data through pagination.
Caching config.get() result at test suite level is a simple, known pattern. Move config access outside the loop or into beforeEach. Single file fix with no dependencies.
Implementing eager loading with Sequelize include() or Mongoose populate() is a scoped fix to the basket route handler. Requires modifying the query logic and potentially updating the test assertion.

Implementing repository pattern requires architectural refactoring across the entire data layer. Affects data/mongodb.ts, data/datacreator.ts, all models/ files, and numerous route files that import models directly. Cross-cutting concern touching 15+ files.

Implementing formal API contract with OpenAPI 3.0 and shared DTOs is an architectural initiative affecting frontend services (10+ files), backend routes (20+ files), and swagger.yml. Requires code generation infrastructure and impacts multiple layers.

Implementing centralized error handling requires creating error classes/middleware on backend and comprehensive HTTP interceptor on frontend. Affects errorHandler.ts, 20+ route files, frontend interceptor, and multiple service files. Cross-cutting architectural concern.

Refactoring scattered auth/authorization logic into AuthService and middleware requires changes to login.ts, 2fa.ts, verify.ts, frontend app.guard.ts, and likely 8+ other route files that inline permission checks. High-impact architectural refactoring of core security concerns.

Consolidating Models/ and Service types into single source of truth is scoped to frontend. Requires creating/updating Models directory and refactoring 6-8 service files. No backend changes needed. Manageable architectural improvement.

Integrating hacking instructor as proper Angular module requires refactoring the tutorial subsystem (~600 LOC) and updating main app integration points. Scoped to frontend hacking-instructor module and app.module.ts. No backend changes.

Creating unified challenge domain service requires refactoring across verify.ts, challenges.yml, frontend score-board module (15+ files), hacking-instructor module (15+ files), and introducing challenge service on backend. Affects 30+ files with deep architectural implications.
